name: Yash Choudhary
headline: Senior Software Engineer
tagline: I build production systems end to end — and I'm learning to read the data they generate.
logLine: MSc Business Analytics @ UCD Smurfit · Dublin, Ireland
summary: Senior full-stack developer with 4.5+ years in fintech and IoT — working across Vue and React frontends and the Python services behind them. I've taken products 0-to-1, including a payment gateway from architecture to launch, architected a monolith-to-microservices migration, hardened auth infrastructure, and shipped integrations now used across 50%+ of their target markets.

Currently pursuing an MSc in Business Analytics at UCD Michael Smurfit Graduate Business School in Dublin. I'm at home in flat, high-autonomy teams where engineers own problems end to end — from architecture to deployment, and increasingly from data to decision.
